pages.text: End gemstone used for Aredrite armor.
Aredrite Ore only generates in the $(l)End$(). Mine it with a $(l)diamond pickaxe or better$().

$(l)Piece effects$()$(br)$(li)$(item)Helmet$(): Removes $(thing)Blindness$() and $(thing)Darkness$()$(li)$(item)Chestplate$(): $(thing)Resistance$() at low health; stronger while $(l)Branded$()$(li)$(item)Leggings$(): Movement speed; stronger in the $(l)End$() and while $(l)Branded$()$(li)$(item)Boots$(): No fall damage in the $(l)End$(), much less elsewhere

$(l)Set bonuses$()$(br)$(li)$(thing)2 pieces, Witnessed$(): armor hardens when hostile mobs are nearby$(li)$(thing)3 pieces, Hollow Pressure$(): with 3+ hostiles nearby, they are slowed and weakened and you get Regeneration$(li)$(thing)4 pieces, Last Horizon$(): while $(l)Branded$(), survive one lethal hit, weaken and reveal nearby enemies, and get a short survival boost. Long cooldown.
